stem_book: State whether the following are true or false. (i) All salts are strong electrolytes. (ii) The degree of ionization of a weak electrolyte increases with dilution. (iii) The degree of ionization is not affected by the concentration of the electrolyte. (iv) Electrolytes are only found in liquid form. (v) A weak electrolyte is one that only partially ionizes in a solution.
reason: Five-part true/false recap with separate answers; manifest split it into 5 entries sharing one code.
work: Salts like HgCl₂, CdBr₂ are weak; α of weak electrolyte rises on dilution; ionic solids are electrolytes too
